Answers to common candidate questions.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Before you apply.

Have a more specific requirement?

Let’s talk↗
Are all published jobs still open?+

No. A notice remaining online does not establish availability. Dated roles with past deadlines are marked closed; undated notices are marked availability unconfirmed. Check the original notice and confirm with the company.

How do I apply?+

Open the role page, review the eligibility and follow the original notification’s application process. Different engagements may require different methods.

Does GA Digital charge a job-placement fee?+

The formal notice dated 14 June 2025 states that no job-placement fee is charged. A separate source banner mentions a refundable joining deposit. Read the full notices and verify any current requirement directly with the company.

Where can I raise a recruitment or employee concern?+

Use the grievance and support page or email info@gadigital.in. Include the project or vacancy reference and a concise description of the concern.
